title: Jesus... He Cheated And Still Got The Higher Marks
topic: angry that a classmate who cheated got better marks

bible.text: Be still before the LORD and wait patiently for Him; do not fret when men prosper in their ways, when they carry out wicked schemes.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... he cheated and still got higher marks than me. 😠

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I studied every night. I didn't cheat because of You.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: It's unfair. I saw every night you studied.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Then why does doing the right thing feel like losing?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Marks count one paper. I count who you're becoming. You kept yourself.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Keep your hands clean. Let Me handle the scoreboard.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Which line did you need today?
